# openobserve_alerts (Data Source)

Lists the alerts of an OpenObserve organization, optionally scoped to one folder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_alerts" "all" {}

# Alerts that are configured but not currently being evaluated.
output "disabled_alerts" {
  value = [for a in data.openobserve_alerts.all.alerts : a.name if !a.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Restrict the listing to one alert folder.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `alerts` (Attributes List) The alerts found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `id` (String) Data source ID.

<a id="nestedatt--alerts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alerts`

Read-Only:

- `alert_id` (String) Alert identifier.
- `alert_type` (String) Alert type reported by the server.
- `description` (String) What the alert monitors.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert is evaluated.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder holding the alert.
- `folder_name` (String) Name of that folder.
- `is_real_time` (Boolean) Whether the alert evaluates as data arrives.
- `name` (String) Alert name.
- `owner` (String) Alert owner.
